restrictions: Target sha256-r38-prefix-v1 exactly: SHA-256 steps 0..37 on every padded block, the standard IV once, FIPS 180-4 padding, feed-forward, all eight digest words; outputs two distinct 128-byte messages M0 || M1, M0 || M1' with equal digests.

Construction: the variant-table attack of the HashSmash lineage (c99df2dc, 0ae69bcb, aed05522, 1db43310) on the two-block framework of ePrint 2026/1120, instantiated with the characteristic NEW3 found by our own measured search (state trail equal to the published one with members swapped; different signed message difference in W10, W11, W23).

Cost: exact ledger ledger_n3.py: N_G = 146,227,926,952,758,750,725 groups, 64 tables, counted-program operation counts of the lineage (H7), preprocessing scaled per pass, allowances 2^45 + 2^50 + 2^50 from the measured campaign; T x 2728 = 2538710716289933555947482; claimed 69.65675.
Success probability at least 0.39 under H1, H2 (q3_model 2^-100.0), H5 (delta = 1) and H6 (SR lower bound), by Bonferroni per group, independent groups and Chebyshev caps.
Memory (reported): 2^80.26 bytes; the claim is a time bound in the word-RAM model with unit-cost table access (H3).

heuristics.statement: For a first block M0 drawn with fresh coins, CV1 = F_38(IV, M0) behaves as a uniform 256-bit value for the events of one fixed variant: (Y, Z0) and W7 are uniform, as in the variant-table lineage.
heuristics.scope: Expected work counters and the per-variant success probability.
heuristics.extrapolation: Same structure as the lineage (aed05522 H1); Step-2 bijection: for a uniform CV1, (W0..W7) is uniform.
heuristics.limitations: A premise; not re-measured on real chaining values for NEW3.

heuristics.statement: The average of q3(v) = Pr[rows 16..37 follow the trail and its derived conditions | W7 in F7] over the variants examined is at least q3_model = 2^-100.0.
heuristics.scope: S_model, N_G and the whole attack term.
heuristics.extrapolation: Six estimator runs on S* (Section 7): mean 2^-99.7471, 99% bound 2^-99.8946, 5,901 successes, all verified collisions; the same estimator gives 2^-101.05 for the published characteristic (paper conditions: 2^-101.0); stage factors integer-like; one explicit 38-step SFS pair checked with the organizer reference.
heuristics.limitations: Participant-run Monte Carlo on one dense part; the variants change W8..W10 values (rows 23..25), not re-measured per variant.

heuristics.statement: Unit-cost table access in the 256-bit word RAM of collision-frontier-v5; memory (2^80.26 bytes) is reported, not scored.
heuristics.scope: The online cost per (CV1, A0) lookup.
heuristics.extrapolation: Text of the cost model, as used by every filing of the lineage.
heuristics.limitations: Without unit-cost tables the claim does not hold.

heuristics.statement: The computation spent to obtain NEW3, S* and everything else for this package is at most A_C + A_S + DEV = 2^45 + 2^50 + 2^50 target compressions.
heuristics.scope: The allowance part of the ledger (negligible against T).
heuristics.extrapolation: One 10-core machine for 24.0 hours in all (863,260 core-seconds = 2^19.72) at 2^21.383 units per core-second (calibration of aed05522/6eeefb64) = 2^41.1 units; NEW3 itself: 2,586 s search + 1,262 s coupling check.
heuristics.limitations: A wall-clock bound; inputs from the literature (shape, published weight profile as bounds) are disclosed (Section 9).

heuristics.statement: The expected number of further successes on the chaining value of a success is at most delta = 1.
heuristics.scope: The group success bound S (1 - delta/2).
heuristics.extrapolation: The budget of 0ae69bcb; the lineage measured far smaller values (0.04 in 1db43310) for the mirrored trail.

heuristics.statement: SR = sum of |R_j| over the 64 A0 values of Section 5 is at least 128,114,134,546.
heuristics.scope: N_G, the caps and the table sizes.
heuristics.extrapolation: Selection on an independent screening run; 85,421 valid of 256,000,000 fresh samples; one-sided 99% lower bound.
heuristics.limitations: Statistical bound, not an exhaustive count.

heuristics.statement: The executed per-path operation counts of the public counted program (aed05522/1db43310) apply to NEW3 with its constants, and the preprocessing passes scale with their drivers (zero/prefix with tables, count/fill with SR x |G'|).
heuristics.scope: Every operation count of the ledger.
heuristics.extrapolation: The program's paths do not depend on the constants (immediates); deep-path and first-test fractions are charged at 2^-14 and 2^-6 of the W7 passes, above the measured rates.
heuristics.limitations: Not re-counted for NEW3 by an executed interpreter.
